i.norm: Verifies that {@link ByteUtils#fromLittleEndian(java.io.InputStream, int)} reads four bytes from a stream and assembles them into an unsigned 32-bit value, treating the first byte as the least significant (little-endian order).
Four little-endian bytes: 0x02 (lowest) ... 0x80 (highest). The 0x80 high byte makes the value exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE, so it must be returned as an unsigned 32-bit number.
Reconstruct the number by weighting each byte with its base-256 position.
